The '''Tainer family''', previously known as the '''Doran family''', was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] bloodline affiliated with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[New Jedi Order]] as [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and for some of its members as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].
